record.paper_title: Approximating network dynamics: Some open problems
record.original_question: In the Erdős-Rényi random-digraph setting reviewed in Subsection 3.2 for the special case p_i = th_i = 1 and edge probability π(n) = c/n, prove that the critical constant c_crit governing the phase transition identified in Theorem 3.2 is exactly 1.

evidence.quote: Note that Theorem 3.2 only tells us that 1 ≤ ccrit≤ 2, but simulations strongly suggest that ccrit = 1. ... Problem 1. (How) can one prove that ccrit = 1?

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published proof or refutation of the conjecture that the critical constant for this threshold-1 activation process on the Erdős–Rényi random digraph $D(n, c/n)$ equals 1. The problem was posed as an open question and only $1 \le c_{\mathrm{crit}} \le 2$ appears to be rigorously established in the literature; simulations support $c_{\mathrm{crit}}=1$ but no formal resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Approximating network dynamics: Some open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems on discrete-time finite-state dynamical system models approximating ODE models, including critical thresholds.
status_evidence.claim: The question of whether c_crit = 1 in this digraph activation model is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Large Deviations for Subcritical Bootstrap Percolation on the Erdős–Rényi Graph
status_evidence.snippet: Bootstrap percolation thresholds on Erdős–Rényi graphs are studied, but for undirected graphs and different threshold regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Existing rigorous results on related Erdős–Rényi bootstrap percolation models do not directly settle the directed-graph c_crit=1 conjecture.
